save_to_dir.description: Save collected hardware data to a directory named 'grml-hwinfo-TIMESTAMP' (equivalent to -d option)

save_to_tarball.description: Save collected hardware data to a tarball named 'grml-hwinfo-TIMESTAMP.tar.bz2' (equivalent to -f option)

output_dir.description: Custom directory path for storing hwinfo data; when empty, uses current working directory

extra_args.description: List of additional command-line arguments to pass directly to grml-hwinfo command
